definition: Used to add a new topic or extra information to a conversation.
exampleSentence: By the way, did you remember to send the report to Ali?

definition: Used to say yes or to show that something is clear or expected.
exampleSentence: Of course you can borrow my charger if your battery is low.

definition: Not less than a certain amount.
exampleSentence: You should sleep at least seven hours every night to stay healthy.

definition: As quickly as you can.
exampleSentence: Please reply to this email as soon as possible because the deadline is tomorrow.

definition: Used to say what is really true, often something surprising.
exampleSentence: The test looked hard, but in fact it was quite easy for everyone.

definition: Used before giving one case that shows what you mean.
exampleSentence: Many fruits, for example apples and oranges, are rich in vitamin C.

definition: At the planned time, not late.
exampleSentence: The train left on time, so we arrived at the meeting early.

definition: Early enough to do something or to not miss it.
exampleSentence: We got to the cinema just in time to see the beginning of the film.

definition: Now, at this time.
exampleSentence: I am busy at the moment, but I can call you back in an hour.

definition: Also, in addition.
exampleSentence: She speaks English fluently, and she knows a little German as well.

definition: At this exact moment, or immediately.
exampleSentence: The manager is in a meeting right now, so please wait a few minutes.

definition: To check that something is true or done.
exampleSentence: Always make sure the door is locked before you leave the house.

definition: To be careful, or a friendly way to say goodbye.
exampleSentence: Take care when you drive on icy roads in the winter.

definition: To feel happy and excited about something that will happen.
exampleSentence: I look forward to meeting you at the conference next month.

definition: To discover a fact or piece of information.
exampleSentence: We need to find out why the website is loading so slowly.

definition: To stop trying to do something.
exampleSentence: Learning a language is hard, but you should never give up.

definition: To prepare or install something so it is ready to use.
exampleSentence: It took us about an hour to set up the new printer in the office.

definition: To understand something or find the answer by thinking.
exampleSentence: I could not figure out how to change the settings on my new phone.

definition: To watch, listen or think carefully.
exampleSentence: Please pay attention to the instructions before you start the exam.

definition: To join an activity or event with other people.
exampleSentence: More than two hundred students will take part in the coding competition.

definition: Used to show the purpose of an action.
exampleSentence: She studies every evening in order to pass the final exam.

definition: In place of someone or something else.
exampleSentence: I usually drink tea instead of coffee in the afternoon.

definition: As said or shown by a person or a source.
exampleSentence: According to the weather forecast, it will rain all weekend.

definition: Only if a certain condition is true.
exampleSentence: You can use my laptop as long as you are careful with it.

definition: Used to say that something happens although something else is true.
exampleSentence: He went to work even though he had a bad cold.

definition: Used to introduce a different or opposite point.
exampleSentence: The city is exciting; on the other hand, it is very expensive to live there.

definition: Very quickly and without warning.
exampleSentence: We were watching a movie when all of a sudden the lights went out.

definition: Finally, after a long time or many events.
exampleSentence: We had many problems with the project, but in the end it was a success.

definition: Used to introduce the first and most important point.
exampleSentence: First of all, I would like to thank everyone for coming today.

definition: At the beginning, before something changed.
exampleSentence: At first the software seemed difficult, but now I use it every day.

definition: A friendly answer to thanks or to a request.
exampleSentence: When I thanked him for his help, he smiled and said no problem.

definition: Used to say that something is not important anymore.
exampleSentence: Never mind, I found my keys in my coat pocket after all.

definition: Used to make a suggestion.
exampleSentence: How about going for a walk in the park after lunch?

definition: A polite way to get attention or to say sorry.
exampleSentence: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?

definition: Words used to show that you are grateful.
exampleSentence: Thank you so much for helping me move all these boxes today.

definition: A friendly way to say goodbye.
exampleSentence: I have to go to class now, so see you later this evening.

definition: A polite way to say goodbye and wish someone well.
exampleSentence: The cashier gave me my receipt and said have a nice day.

definition: A polite thing to say when you meet someone for the first time.
exampleSentence: Hello, I am the new developer on the team, nice to meet you.

definition: A large number or amount of something.
exampleSentence: There are a lot of people waiting outside the stadium tonight.

definition: In the same way as normally happens.
exampleSentence: As usual, my brother arrived late to the family dinner.
